title: Zhipu&\#x27;s GLM-5.4 debuts looped transformer architecture for coding
summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first model built on a looped transformer architecture, in which a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations to deepen the network without increasing parameter count. The coding-focused model is not available as open weights and cannot currently be reached through Z.ai&\#x27;s regular API or OpenRouter; access requires the Coding Plan subscription, whose API key works with the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API at https://api.z.ai/api/v1. Simon Willison tested it through that route and found its "pelican riding a bicycle" outputs similar in quality to GLM-5.3, while the architecture description remains a vendor claim without independent benchmark results in the source.
